title: The Twin-Court Javelin Treatise
summary: An elite treatise on fighting with a javelin in each hand in strict pairs, each hand answering the other.

title: Hawk's Reach: Elite Forms of the Thrown Spear
summary: Elite forms that give the thrown spear the long reach and the sudden fall of a hawk upon its prey.

title: The Azure Basin Throw
summary: Teaches throws shaped like the curve of a basin, gathering qi first and loosing it in a single wave.

title: River-Crossing Canon of the Two Banks
summary: A canon for throwing across a river from bank to bank and for guarding against a throw that comes the same way.

title: Forms of the Paired Flight
summary: Teaches loosing two javelins so that they fly as a pair and the second follows the first into the same wound.

title: The High Azure Stoop and Its Answers
summary: Teaches how to meet an enemy striking from above and how to answer a stoop with a rising throw.

title: Oath of the Far Bearing: Elite Gale Forms
summary: Elite forms for the wind-sworn thrower who swears to a far mark and does not release until the bearing is true.

title: Plateau Gale-Throw Treatise
summary: A treatise on gathering the gale of the high plateau into the arm and the shaft for one great throw.

title: The Wind-Sworn Long Cast
summary: Teaches the wind-sworn throw that rides a following wind to reach beyond the sight of the thrower.

title: Bearing and Oath: A Canon of the Thrown Shaft
summary: A canon that ties each throw to a bearing taken and an oath spoken before the shaft leaves the hand.

title: Forms of the Storm-Edge Skirmisher
summary: Forms for a skirmisher who runs the edge of a storm front and throws from within its blind cover.

title: The Open-Plateau Javelin Canon
summary: A canon of fighting on open plateau with no cover and no retreat, where every throw must count.
